projects.title: ShelfScan - Final Degree Project
projects.stack: React · Vite · Supabase · Vision-language model (LoRA) · Cloud GPUs · Netlify

lines.label: Need
lines.text: digitise data from paper delivery notes, removing manual data entry.

lines.label: Idea
lines.text: combine OCR with a fine-tuned vision-language model to extract structured data automatically.

lines.label: Build
lines.text: production pipeline (OCR + LLM API + Supabase) extracting structured JSON (supplier, tax ID, date, items, totals), self-hosted and live; parallel academic track fine-tuning a small vision-language model with LoRA/PEFT on rented cloud GPUs, with a real dataset augmented ~10x.
